central_rule: Stage-4 correspondence is a qualification gate for a regulatory evidence family; its aggregate Delta/LCB/p-value/null statistics are never themselves teacher-state coordinates.

stage4_role.qualifies: whether the frozen RNA↔regulatory correspondence design is interpretable above matched controls under the prospective Phase-B/Stage-4 design
stage4_role.if_stage4_passes: authorizes consideration of the frozen regulatory mapping/evidence family for a separately audited teacher-state feature producer; it does not authorize training
stage4_role.if_stage4_interpretable_but_null: record as a null qualification outcome; do not invent a positive regulatory axis
stage4_role.if_stage4_uninterpretable: regulatory evidence family is blocked from teacher-state signal until the methodological failure is prospectively repaired

candidate_inputs: lawful RNA evidence used by the richer teacher
paired ATAC/regulatory measurements from the authorized training population
frozen regulatory mapping whose evidence family has passed its own qualification
SCENIC+ outputs only after current provenance/leakage qualification
perturbational evidence only in the role prospectively assigned by its own contract
forbidden_inputs: Stage-4 primary Delta as a cell feature
Stage-4 p-value/LCB as a cell feature
disease/demographic/protected outcome used to choose state
dataset ID or donor ID encoded as biology
prospective_teacher_feature_producer.training_unit_rule: The teacher-state producer must emit a state aligned to the eventual student training unit. Phase-B donor/metacell audit artifacts are not automatically a training tensor.
prospective_teacher_feature_producer.observation_operator_rule: physical acquisition descriptors may correct how evidence was observed; arbitrary source identity may not define biology
prospective_teacher_feature_producer.missingness_rule: unavailable privileged evidence stays explicitly unavailable/masked and may widen uncertainty; it is not a measured zero

representation.rotation_and_basis: When coordinate identity is not stable, authority attaches to the subspace/geometry. Coordinate-specific biological names require independent basis stability.

evidence_fusion.source_disagreement: reported/preserved rather than resolved by selecting the favorable modality
evidence_fusion.perturbation_role: may anchor biological interpretation or validate state only if its split/lineage contract prevents target leakage; no automatic feature authority

required_receipts_before_materialization: source registry with custody/provenance for every privileged evidence family
